answer: A hostile operator running 127 aliases as a result needs 88 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in sable, expire in ripple, and spiral lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 107 dollars in locked collateral and another 10 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
